tools.name: list_profiles

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Get the full grow recipe for one mushroom by slug (e.g. 'lions-mane', 'pearl-oyster', 'shiitake'): every stage with days, temperature (C and F), humidity, fresh air exchange (fan) and light hours, plus chamber tips and sources.

tools.name: search_grow_content
tools.description: Search Shroom Labs grow profiles, troubleshooting guides (not pinning, contamination, leggy stems, humidity and fresh air) and blog posts. Returns titles, short descriptions and canonical URLs to cite.

tools.name: get_chamber_guide
tools.description: Get Shroom Labs guides for automated mushroom grow chambers: which chambers work ('chambers'), installing free OpenShrooly firmware on a Shrooly chamber ('install'), what happened to the Shrooly app ('what-happened-to-shrooly'), keeping a Terrashroom running ('terrashroom'), and more. tools.name: grow_timeline
tools.description: Day by day timeline for growing one mushroom: each stage with its start day, end day and conditions, and the total days from start to harvest. Use for 'how long does X take to grow'.
